{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

data:
{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

    total

    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

data:
{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

data:
{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

data:
{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total

    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}

{"operationName":"UserLists","variables":{},"query":"query UserLists($input: ListPagination) {
  listGetAll(input: $input, includeUnavailableProductPlaceholders: true) {
    total
    count
    offset
    results {
      id
      name
      createdAt
      lastModifiedAt
      version
      lineItems {
        id
        product {
          id
          productCode
          name
          primaryImage(size: THUMBNAIL)
          overrideUrl
          slug
          __typename
        }
        productVariant {
          id
          sku
          salePercentage
          price {
            formattedAmount
            formattedValue
            currencyCode
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          listPrice {
            formattedAmount
            centAmount
            __typename
          }
          attributes {
            availabilityStatus
            availabilityText
            vipAvailabilityStatus
            vipAvailabilityText
            canAddToBag
            canAddToWishlist
            vipCanAddToBag
            onSale
            ageRange
            pieceCount
            featuredFlags {
              key
              label
              __typename
            }
            isNew
            rating
            safetyWarning {
              safetyWarningKey: key
              safetyWarningLabel: label
              showSafetyImage
              imageKey
              __typename
            }
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      description
      isFull
      isPublic
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}"}
